svg.title: Major sixth (M6): information sheet
svg.desc: Major sixth, M6: C4 to A4, 9 semitones. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with both keys highlighted in this interval's identity colour and 9 numbered semitone hops. Two time strips show the notes one after another and together. Plogger [9] lens: Modal family (rounded), → Octave, False-harmonic (Plogger), half-filled/hatched.

g.text: 6 letter names counted inclusively (C to A)
HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
perfect-group family. A family label, not a
The identity colour is a separate, artistic
Next lower: Minor sixth (m6, 8 semitones). Root C4 stays; upper note A4→A♭4, one key apart.
Plogger: A same, B same, C changes.
Next higher: Minor seventh (m7, 10 semitones). Root C4 stays; upper note A4→B♭4, one key
apart. Plogger: A changes, B same, C changes.
How to read: find C4 on your keyboard, then count 9 keys up, white and black, to A4. The
numbered arcs are those hops. Top left shows the two notes one after another, top right
